# pi theme generator

> Browser tool to create and export color themes for the pi coding agent.

## About

- pi theme generator is a browser tool that creates and exports color themes for the pi coding agent.
- It builds a palette and applies it to the 56 pi color roles.
- The export is a theme JSON file for ~/.pi/agent/themes/.

## Use

- Build a palette.
- Apply the palette to the 56 color roles.
- Tweak individual roles.
- Download the theme JSON.

## Links

- [pi](https://pi.dev): the pi coding agent.
- [pi themes documentation](https://pi.dev/docs/latest/themes): documentation for pi themes.
